statuses.listed: Live in the destination's public listing; verified by reading the listing.
statuses.available_tested: Works today, and we have observed it working (traffic from that client in our own analytics, or a test we ran).
statuses.compatible_untested: The destination's own current documentation supports a remote Streamable HTTP server with no sign in; we have not run it end to end ourselves.
statuses.submitted: Submitted and waiting on the destination's review.
statuses.prepared: Everything the destination asks for is written and in mcp/distribution/; it needs an account only the owner holds.
statuses.blocked: Cannot proceed until the named dependency is met.
statuses.unsupported: The destination does not support custom MCP servers; the alternative is named.
